title: Jaylon Tyson Rookie Card 2024-25 Panini NBA Hoops #250
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a Jaylon Tyson Rookie Card from the 2024-25 Panini NBA Hoops set. The card features a standard size on card stock material and is an original base rookie card. It belongs to the National Basketball Association (NBA) league, specifically for the Cleveland Cavaliers. The card number is 250 and it is in English.
